<section id="sec-why-triton" class="level2" data-number="6.1">
<h2 data-number="6.1" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-why-triton"><span class="header-section-number">6.1</span> Vì sao cần Triton — và không phải gì?</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>FastAPI + <code>session.run()</code> đã đủ production chưa — Triton thêm gì?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Triton biến nhiều artifact (<code>onnx</code>/<code>plan</code>/<code>pt</code>/<code>py</code>…) thành service có <strong>HTTP/gRPC, validation, batching, concurrency, multi-model, versioning, health, metrics</strong>. Nó <strong>không thay</strong> TensorRT hay ORT — nó <strong>serve</strong> chúng. <code>frontend ≠ scheduler ≠ backend ≠ model instance</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Production cần thêm ngoài “chạy model”: endpoint, request validation, batching, concurrency, multi-model, versioning, health, metrics, rollout, GPU tuning.</p>
<p>Tự viết FastAPI thường phải tự lo parse → preprocess → H2D → runtime → batch thủ công → concurrent → versions → metrics → readiness → rollback.</p>
<p>Triton flow:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>client → HTTP/gRPC → frontend → per-model scheduler
  → backend runtime → model instance → response</code></pre>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%">
<col style="width: 25%">
<col style="width: 50%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Công cụ</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Vai trò</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Liên quan Triton</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">ONNX</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">IR / interchange</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Serve qua ORT backend</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">ONNX Runtime</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Chạy ONNX</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Có ORT backend</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">TensorRT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Compiler/runtime NVIDIA</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Serve <code>.plan</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Triton</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Inference serving server</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Queue, batch, versions, metrics</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Kubernetes</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Orchestration</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Deploy Triton pod</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">FastAPI</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Web generic</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thiếu inference scheduler/batching chuyên dụng</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">vLLM / TRT-LLM</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">LLM serving</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Có thể gắn như backend</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre class="text"><code>ONNX/TensorRT: how to execute efficiently.
Triton: how to serve that execution to many clients.</code></pre>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-5-contents" aria-controls="callout-5" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Mental model 5 khối + multi-model
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-5" class="callout-5-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Client → Frontend → <strong>Model repository</strong> (<code>model</code> + <code>config.pbtxt</code>) → <strong>Per-model scheduler</strong> (batch/queue) → <strong>Backend</strong> → <strong>Model instances</strong> (GPU/CPU).</p>
<p>Mỗi model có scheduler/config/backend/instances <strong>riêng</strong>. Một server có thể đồng thời: <code>image_classifier_trt</code> (GPU0 + dynamic batch), <code>text_embedding_onnx</code> (GPU1), <code>preprocess_python</code> (CPU), <code>llm_vllm</code> (GPU2/3).</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-architecture" class="level2" data-number="6.2">
<h2 data-number="6.2" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-architecture"><span class="header-section-number">6.2</span> Architecture và request path</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Request đi qua những lớp nào trước khi chạm GPU?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Path: client → frontend (parse/validate) → <strong>scheduler</strong> (default / dynamic / sequence / ensemble) → gán <strong>model instance</strong> → <strong>backend</strong> execute → validate output → metrics → response. Nhầm lẫn lớp sẽ debug sai chỗ (protocol vs queue vs kernel).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="6.5" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">
<div id="fig-l6-request" class="quarto-float quarto-figure quarto-figure-center anchored">
<figure class="quarto-float quarto-float-fig figure">
<div aria-describedby="fig-l6-request-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
<div>
<pre class="mermaid mermaid-js" data-label="fig-l6-request">flowchart TB
  C([Client HTTP/gRPC]) --&gt; F([Frontend validate])
  F --&gt; S([Scheduler])
  S --&gt; I([Instance])
  I --&gt; B([Backend execute])
  B --&gt; O([Response + metrics])
  classDef soft fill:#F7FAFC,stroke:#7B8A9A,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#243447
  classDef hot fill:#FFE082,stroke:#F57F17,stroke-width:3px,color:#5C3B10
  classDef ok fill:#EAF3FF,stroke:#4A90E2,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#1F3A5F
  class C,S,I,O soft
  class F hot
  class B ok
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<figcaption class="quarto-float-caption-bottom quarto-float-caption quarto-float-fig" id="fig-l6-request-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
Hình&nbsp;6.2: Request path: Frontend (tô sáng) validate protocol trước khi vào scheduler.
</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Lớp</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Việc</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Frontend</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Protocol, model name/version, tensor metadata</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Scheduler</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Khi nào chạy; có batch với request khác không</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Backend</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Gọi TRT / ORT / PyTorch / Python / custom</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Instance</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Execution slot thật trên CPU/GPU</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-7-contents" aria-controls="callout-7" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Scheduler types (tóm tắt đủ dùng)
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-7" class="callout-7-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Default:</strong> một request → một execution (không gom batch).<br>
<strong>Dynamic batching:</strong> gom nhiều request thành batch server-side (<a href="#sec-dynbatch" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 6.6</span></a>).<br>
<strong>Sequence batching:</strong> stateful / sequence (ASR, một số RNN).<br>
<strong>Ensemble:</strong> pipeline nhiều model steps — ensemble <strong>không</strong> có compute instance riêng; child models mới có.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-repository" class="level2" data-number="6.3">
<h2 data-number="6.3" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-repository"><span class="header-section-number">6.3</span> Model repository</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Vì sao repository là deployment interface quan trọng nhất của Triton?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Model repository</strong> = filesystem chứa artifact + <code>config.pbtxt</code> + version dirs. Layout sai → model không load. Tên thư mục = model name (trừ khi config set <code>name</code>). Production: package repository từ CI → container/artifact → deploy.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Layout chuẩn:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>&lt;model-repository-path&gt;/
  &lt;model-name&gt;/
    config.pbtxt
    &lt;version&gt;/          # số nguyên: 1, 2, 3…
      &lt;model-definition-file&gt;</code></pre>
<p>Ví dụ:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>model_repository/
  tiny_classifier_onnx/
    config.pbtxt
    1/model.onnx
  tiny_classifier_trt/
    config.pbtxt
    1/model.plan
  normalize_python/
    config.pbtxt
    1/model.py</code></pre>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb7-1"><a href="#cb7-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">tritonserver</span> <span class="at">--model-repository</span><span class="op">=</span>/models</span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a href="#cb7-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a href="#cb7-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">export</span> <span class="va">RELEASE</span><span class="op">=</span>26.04   <span class="co"># chỉnh theo NGC tag bạn dùng</span></span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a href="#cb7-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">docker</span> run <span class="at">--gpus</span> all <span class="at">--rm</span> <span class="at">-it</span> <span class="at">--net</span> host <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a href="#cb7-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">-v</span> <span class="va">$PWD</span>/model_repository:/models <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb7-6"><a href="#cb7-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:<span class="va">${RELEASE}</span>-py3 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb7-7"><a href="#cb7-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  tritonserver <span class="at">--model-repository</span><span class="op">=</span>/models</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p><strong>Version directories:</strong> số nguyên tăng dần. <code>version_policy</code> quyết định version nào serve (ví dụ latest / specific). Client có thể request version cụ thể.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-9-contents" aria-controls="callout-9" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>CI/CD package flow
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-9" class="callout-9-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><code>train/export → validate → benchmark → package repository → push artifact/container → deploy Triton</code>. Không sửa file “live” lung tung trên production filesystem (đặc biệt với poll mode — <a href="#sec-rollout" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 6.9</span></a>).</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-config" class="level2" data-number="6.4">
<h2 data-number="6.4" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-config"><span class="header-section-number">6.4</span> <code>config.pbtxt</code>: trái tim deployment</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p><code>max_batch_size &gt; 0</code> thì <code>dims</code> có gồm batch dimension không?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><code>config.pbtxt</code> mô tả cách Triton load/serve model. Khi <strong><code>max_batch_size &gt; 0</code></strong>, <code>dims</code> <strong>không</strong> gồm batch — request shape = <code>[B] + dims</code>. Khi <strong><code>max_batch_size: 0</code></strong>, <code>dims</code> = full shape (không batch ẩn). Tên I/O phải khớp artifact.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Config tối thiểu (ONNX):</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode protobuf code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode protobuf"><span id="cb8-1"><a href="#cb8-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"tiny_classifier_onnx"</span></span>
<span id="cb8-2"><a href="#cb8-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>backend<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"onnxruntime"</span></span>
<span id="cb8-3"><a href="#cb8-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>max_batch_size<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">8</span></span>
<span id="cb8-4"><a href="#cb8-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb8-5"><a href="#cb8-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>input [</span>
<span id="cb8-6"><a href="#cb8-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  {</span>
<span id="cb8-7"><a href="#cb8-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"input"</span></span>
<span id="cb8-8"><a href="#cb8-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_FP32</span>
<span id="cb8-9"><a href="#cb8-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">28</span>, <span class="dv">28</span> ]</span>
<span id="cb8-10"><a href="#cb8-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  }</span>
<span id="cb8-11"><a href="#cb8-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>]</span>
<span id="cb8-12"><a href="#cb8-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb8-13"><a href="#cb8-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>output [</span>
<span id="cb8-14"><a href="#cb8-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  {</span>
<span id="cb8-15"><a href="#cb8-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"logits"</span></span>
<span id="cb8-16"><a href="#cb8-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_FP32</span>
<span id="cb8-17"><a href="#cb8-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">10</span> ]</span>
<span id="cb8-18"><a href="#cb8-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  }</span>
<span id="cb8-19"><a href="#cb8-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>]</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 43%">
<col style="width: 56%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Field</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ý nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>name</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Nên trùng tên thư mục; set rõ cho đọc được</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>backend</code> / <code>platform</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Loại runtime; hiện đại đọc docs backend</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>max_batch_size</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Batch tối đa Triton được tạo; <code>0</code> = không batching</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>input</code>/<code>output</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>name</code>, <code>data_type</code>, <code>dims</code> khớp model</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Artifact</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Khai báo thường gặp</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">File</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">ONNX</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>backend: "onnxruntime"</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model.onnx</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">TensorRT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>platform: "tensorrt_plan"</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model.plan</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Python</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>backend: "python"</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model.py</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">TorchScript</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>backend: "pytorch"</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model.pt</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre class="text"><code>max_batch_size &gt; 0:  request shape = [B] + config dims
max_batch_size = 0:  request shape = config dims</code></pre>
<p>Ví dụ không batch:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb10"><pre class="sourceCode protobuf code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode protobuf"><span id="cb10-1"><a href="#cb10-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>max_batch_size<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">0</span></span>
<span id="cb10-2"><a href="#cb10-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>input [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"input"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_FP32 dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span> ] }]</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-warning no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Cảnh báo</span>Bẫy thường gặp
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Export ONNX không đặt <code>input_names</code>/<code>output_names</code> → tên kiểu <code>input.1</code>, <code>onnx::Gemm_23</code> → config dễ sai. Export nên đặt tên rõ + <code>dynamic_axes</code> cho batch.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-12-contents" aria-controls="callout-12" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Export ONNX thân thiện Triton
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-12" class="callout-12-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb11"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb11-1"><a href="#cb11-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>torch.onnx.export(</span>
<span id="cb11-2"><a href="#cb11-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    model, example_input, <span class="st">"model.onnx"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb11-3"><a href="#cb11-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    input_names<span class="op">=</span>[<span class="st">"input"</span>], output_names<span class="op">=</span>[<span class="st">"logits"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb11-4"><a href="#cb11-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    dynamic_axes<span class="op">=</span>{<span class="st">"input"</span>: {<span class="dv">0</span>: <span class="st">"batch"</span>}, <span class="st">"logits"</span>: {<span class="dv">0</span>: <span class="st">"batch"</span>}},</span>
<span id="cb11-5"><a href="#cb11-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    opset_version<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">17</span>,</span>
<span id="cb11-6"><a href="#cb11-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-backends" class="level2" data-number="6.5">
<h2 data-number="6.5" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-backends"><span class="header-section-number">6.5</span> Backends: TensorRT, ONNX, Python và khác</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Khi nào serve <code>.plan</code>, khi nào serve <code>.onnx</code>, khi nào Python backend?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Backend</strong> = lớp biết execute artifact. TRT: perf cao, phụ thuộc GPU/version/profile. ORT: dễ/portable hơn. Python: preprocess/postprocess linh hoạt nhưng dễ bottleneck. LLM: vLLM / TensorRT-LLM như backend riêng (Lesson 9).</p>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 30%">
<col style="width: 33%">
<col style="width: 13%">
<col style="width: 23%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Backend</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Artifact</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ưu</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Nhược</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">TensorRT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model.plan</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Latency/throughput tốt; fusion/tactics/precision</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Portability; profiles; build phức tạp</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">ONNX Runtime</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model.onnx</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Dễ deploy; CPU/GPU</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Có thể chậm hơn TRT; fallback EP</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">PyTorch</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model.pt</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Gần training stack</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thường không tối ưu bằng TRT</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Python</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>model.py</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Pre/post, glue logic</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">GIL/CPU; dễ thành bottleneck pipeline</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">DALI / FIL / vLLM / TRT-LLM</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">theo docs</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Pipeline data / tabular / LLM</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Cần hiểu workload riêng</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>TensorRT config tối thiểu:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb12"><pre class="sourceCode protobuf code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode protobuf"><span id="cb12-1"><a href="#cb12-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"resnet50_trt"</span></span>
<span id="cb12-2"><a href="#cb12-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>platform<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"tensorrt_plan"</span></span>
<span id="cb12-3"><a href="#cb12-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>max_batch_size<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">32</span></span>
<span id="cb12-4"><a href="#cb12-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>input [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"input"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_FP32 dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span> ] }]</span>
<span id="cb12-5"><a href="#cb12-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>output [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"logits"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_FP32 dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">1000</span> ] }]</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p><strong>Plan compatibility:</strong> build trên đúng GPU arch + TensorRT/CUDA của môi trường deploy (Lesson 4). Dynamic batching phải khớp <strong>optimization profiles</strong> — <code>max_batch_size</code> Triton không được vượt <code>max</code> profile.</p>
<p><strong>Python backend khi nào:</strong> preprocess/postprocess, feature engineering nhẹ, glue không có backend native. Tránh logic nặng trên critical path nếu GPU model đã nhanh.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-14-contents" aria-controls="callout-14" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Protocols và client
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-14" class="callout-14-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Triton expose HTTP (thường <code>:8000</code>), gRPC (<code>:8001</code>), metrics (<code>:8002</code>). Client: <code>tritonclient</code> Python (HTTP/gRPC), Perf Analyzer. gRPC thường tốt hơn cho binary tensor throughput cao; HTTP tiện debug. KServe/V2 inference protocol là chuẩn API.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-dynbatch" class="level2" data-number="6.6">
<h2 data-number="6.6" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-dynbatch"><span class="header-section-number">6.6</span> Dynamic batching deep dive</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Vì sao throughput tăng nhưng p99 có thể xấu — và <code>preferred_batch_size</code> khi nào dùng?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Dynamic batching gom nhiều request (thường batch-1) thành batch lớn hơn server-side. Có ích khi traffic dày, model batchable, GPU chưa saturate ở batch 1, SLO cho phép queue delay. Tune theo <strong>SLO (p99)</strong>, không chỉ throughput. Bắt đầu <code>dynamic_batching { }</code> — <strong>không</strong> set <code>preferred_batch_size</code> mặc định nếu chưa có bằng chứng benchmark.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Ví dụ số:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>Batch 1 latency: 3 ms  →  8 request riêng: 8×3 = 24 ms GPU time
Batch 8 latency: 8 ms  →  1 batch: 8 ms GPU time</code></pre>
<p>Throughput tăng; mỗi request có thể thêm queue delay.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 50%">
<col style="width: 50%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Có ích khi</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ít ích khi</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Nhiều request batch-1</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Traffic thấp</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU chưa saturate</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Model không batch / shape lệch nhiều</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">SLO cho phép delay nhỏ</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Pre/post là bottleneck; p99 quá chặt</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Compute giảm tương đối khi batch↑</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Client đã gửi batch lớn; LLM cần continuous batching</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb14"><pre class="sourceCode protobuf code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode protobuf"><span id="cb14-1"><a href="#cb14-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>max_batch_size<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">32</span></span>
<span id="cb14-2"><a href="#cb14-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb14-3"><a href="#cb14-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>dynamic_batching { }</span>
<span id="cb14-4"><a href="#cb14-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb14-5"><a href="#cb14-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a># hoặc có delay<span class="op">:</span></span>
<span id="cb14-6"><a href="#cb14-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>dynamic_batching {</span>
<span id="cb14-7"><a href="#cb14-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  max_queue_delay_microseconds<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">100</span></span>
<span id="cb14-8"><a href="#cb14-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span>
<span id="cb14-9"><a href="#cb14-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb14-10"><a href="#cb14-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a># chỉ khi benchmark chứng minh batch <span class="dv">4</span>/<span class="dv">8</span>/<span class="dv">16</span> đặc biệt tốt<span class="op">:</span></span>
<span id="cb14-11"><a href="#cb14-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>dynamic_batching {</span>
<span id="cb14-12"><a href="#cb14-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  preferred_batch_size<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">4</span>, <span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="dv">16</span> ]</span>
<span id="cb14-13"><a href="#cb14-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 50%">
<col style="width: 50%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Tham số</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ý nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>max_batch_size</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Batch tối đa; quá lớn → latency/memory/profile spike</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>max_queue_delay_microseconds</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Giữ request chờ thêm peer; dài hơn → batch lớn hơn, p99 rủi ro hơn</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>preferred_batch_size</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Ưu tiên các batch “ngon”; không đặt mặc định</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>Shape compatibility:</strong> <code>[1,3,224,224]</code>×N có thể batch; <code>224</code> vs <code>256</code> vs <code>384</code> khó — cần resize/pad, bucket, tách endpoint, hoặc kiểm soát dynamic shape.</p>
<p>Trade-off p99 (ví dụ):</p>
<pre class="text"><code>Without batching:  p50=8ms  p99=20ms   thr=300 rps
With dyn batch:    p50=12ms p99=80ms   thr=1100 rps</code></pre>
<p>SLO <code>p99 &lt; 100ms</code> → có thể OK. SLO <code>p99 &lt; 30ms</code> → thất bại dù thr cao.</p>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="5.5" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">
<div id="fig-l6-batch" class="quarto-float quarto-figure quarto-figure-center anchored">

Hình&nbsp;6.3: Dynamic batching: queue delay đổi throughput ↔︎ p99.
</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-16-contents" aria-controls="callout-16" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Bốn khái niệm dễ nhầm
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-16" class="callout-16-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<ol type="1">
<li><strong>Client concurrency</strong> — số client đồng thời<br>
</li>
<li><strong>Client batch size</strong> — batch mỗi request client gửi<br>
</li>
<li><strong>Dynamic batch size</strong> — batch Triton gom server-side<br>
</li>
<li><strong>Instance count</strong> — số execution slot song song</li>
</ol>
<p>Đừng nhầm “client gửi batch=8” với “dynamic batching đang hoạt động”.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-instances" class="level2" data-number="6.7">
<h2 data-number="6.7" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-instances"><span class="header-section-number">6.7</span> <code>instance_group</code> và concurrent execution</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Tăng <code>count</code> khi nào giúp — khi nào hại?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Model instance</strong> = execution slot. Dynamic batching gom request; <strong>nhiều instances</strong> chạy song song. Tăng <code>count</code> hữu ích khi một instance chưa saturate GPU / nhiều concurrent / model nhỏ. Hại khi model lớn (VRAM), GPU đã full, hoặc contention.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb16"><pre class="sourceCode protobuf code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode protobuf"><span id="cb16-1"><a href="#cb16-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>instance_group [</span>
<span id="cb16-2"><a href="#cb16-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  { count<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">2</span> kind<span class="op">:</span> KIND_GPU }</span>
<span id="cb16-3"><a href="#cb16-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>]</span>
<span id="cb16-4"><a href="#cb16-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb16-5"><a href="#cb16-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a># chỉ định GPU<span class="op">:</span></span>
<span id="cb16-6"><a href="#cb16-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>instance_group [</span>
<span id="cb16-7"><a href="#cb16-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  { count<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">1</span> kind<span class="op">:</span> KIND_GPU gpus<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">0</span> ] },</span>
<span id="cb16-8"><a href="#cb16-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  { count<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">2</span> kind<span class="op">:</span> KIND_GPU gpus<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">1</span> ] }</span>
<span id="cb16-9"><a href="#cb16-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>]</span>
<span id="cb16-10"><a href="#cb16-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb16-11"><a href="#cb16-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>instance_group [</span>
<span id="cb16-12"><a href="#cb16-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  { count<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">2</span> kind<span class="op">:</span> KIND_CPU }</span>
<span id="cb16-13"><a href="#cb16-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>]</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<pre class="text"><code>model: resnet50_trt
  instance 0 → GPU 0
  instance 1 → GPU 0
  instance 2 → GPU 1</code></pre>
<p>Tune cùng dynamic batching: benchmark matrix (batch delay × instance count × concurrency) — không chỉnh một nút theo cảm tính.</p>
<section id="python-backend-preprocess" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="python-backend-preprocess">Python backend (preprocess)</h3>
<pre class="text"><code>model_repository/normalize_python/config.pbtxt + 1/model.py</code></pre>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb19"><pre class="sourceCode protobuf code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode protobuf"><span id="cb19-1"><a href="#cb19-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"normalize_python"</span></span>
<span id="cb19-2"><a href="#cb19-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>backend<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"python"</span></span>
<span id="cb19-3"><a href="#cb19-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>max_batch_size<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">8</span></span>
<span id="cb19-4"><a href="#cb19-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>input [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"INPUT"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_UINT8 dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span> ] }]</span>
<span id="cb19-5"><a href="#cb19-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>output [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"OUTPUT"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_FP32 dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span> ] }]</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb20"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb20-1"><a href="#cb20-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> numpy <span class="im">as</span> np</span>
<span id="cb20-2"><a href="#cb20-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> triton_python_backend_utils <span class="im">as</span> pb_utils</span>
<span id="cb20-3"><a href="#cb20-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-4"><a href="#cb20-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">class</span> TritonPythonModel:</span>
<span id="cb20-5"><a href="#cb20-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="kw">def</span> initialize(<span class="va">self</span>, args):</span>
<span id="cb20-6"><a href="#cb20-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="va">self</span>.mean <span class="op">=</span> np.array([<span class="fl">0.485</span>, <span class="fl">0.456</span>, <span class="fl">0.406</span>], np.float32).reshape(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb20-7"><a href="#cb20-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="va">self</span>.std <span class="op">=</span> np.array([<span class="fl">0.229</span>, <span class="fl">0.224</span>, <span class="fl">0.225</span>], np.float32).reshape(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb20-8"><a href="#cb20-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-9"><a href="#cb20-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="kw">def</span> execute(<span class="va">self</span>, requests):</span>
<span id="cb20-10"><a href="#cb20-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        responses <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb20-11"><a href="#cb20-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">for</span> request <span class="kw">in</span> requests:</span>
<span id="cb20-12"><a href="#cb20-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            x <span class="op">=</span> pb_utils.get_input_tensor_by_name(request, <span class="st">"INPUT"</span>).as_numpy()</span>
<span id="cb20-13"><a href="#cb20-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            x <span class="op">=</span> x.astype(np.float32) <span class="op">/</span> <span class="fl">255.0</span></span>
<span id="cb20-14"><a href="#cb20-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            y <span class="op">=</span> (x <span class="op">-</span> <span class="va">self</span>.mean) <span class="op">/</span> <span class="va">self</span>.std</span>
<span id="cb20-15"><a href="#cb20-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            responses.append(</span>
<span id="cb20-16"><a href="#cb20-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                pb_utils.InferenceResponse(</span>
<span id="cb20-17"><a href="#cb20-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                    output_tensors<span class="op">=</span>[pb_utils.Tensor(<span class="st">"OUTPUT"</span>, y.astype(np.float32))]</span>
<span id="cb20-18"><a href="#cb20-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                )</span>
<span id="cb20-19"><a href="#cb20-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            )</span>
<span id="cb20-20"><a href="#cb20-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">return</span> responses</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Python dễ bottleneck nếu: loop thay NumPy, copy nhiều, decode image nặng trên critical path. Cân nhắc DALI, client-side preprocess, hoặc fuse vào graph. Dùng khi logic nhẹ / prototype; tránh khi p99 cực thấp hoặc thr rất cao.</p>
</section>
<section id="ensemble-pipeline" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="ensemble-pipeline">Ensemble pipeline</h3>
<pre class="text"><code>RAW_IMAGE → preprocess_python → classifier_trt → postprocess_python → LABEL</code></pre>
<p>Ensemble <strong>không</strong> có compute instance — child models mới có. Cẩn shape/name mapping và Python bottleneck.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-18-contents" aria-controls="callout-18" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Ensemble <code>config.pbtxt</code> đầy đủ (concept)
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-18" class="callout-18-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb22"><pre class="sourceCode protobuf code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode protobuf"><span id="cb22-1"><a href="#cb22-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"image_classifier_pipeline"</span></span>
<span id="cb22-2"><a href="#cb22-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>platform<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"ensemble"</span></span>
<span id="cb22-3"><a href="#cb22-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>max_batch_size<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">8</span></span>
<span id="cb22-4"><a href="#cb22-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>input [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"RAW_IMAGE"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_UINT8 dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span> ] }]</span>
<span id="cb22-5"><a href="#cb22-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>output [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"LABEL"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_STRING dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">1</span> ] }]</span>
<span id="cb22-6"><a href="#cb22-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>ensemble_scheduling {</span>
<span id="cb22-7"><a href="#cb22-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  step [</span>
<span id="cb22-8"><a href="#cb22-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    {</span>
<span id="cb22-9"><a href="#cb22-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      model_name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"preprocess_python"</span></span>
<span id="cb22-10"><a href="#cb22-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      model_version<span class="op">:</span> -<span class="dv">1</span></span>
<span id="cb22-11"><a href="#cb22-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      input_map { key<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"INPUT"</span> value<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"RAW_IMAGE"</span> }</span>
<span id="cb22-12"><a href="#cb22-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      output_map { key<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"OUTPUT"</span> value<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"PREPROCESSED"</span> }</span>
<span id="cb22-13"><a href="#cb22-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    },</span>
<span id="cb22-14"><a href="#cb22-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    {</span>
<span id="cb22-15"><a href="#cb22-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      model_name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"classifier_trt"</span></span>
<span id="cb22-16"><a href="#cb22-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      model_version<span class="op">:</span> -<span class="dv">1</span></span>
<span id="cb22-17"><a href="#cb22-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      input_map { key<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"input"</span> value<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"PREPROCESSED"</span> }</span>
<span id="cb22-18"><a href="#cb22-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      output_map { key<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"logits"</span> value<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"LOGITS"</span> }</span>
<span id="cb22-19"><a href="#cb22-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    },</span>
<span id="cb22-20"><a href="#cb22-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    {</span>
<span id="cb22-21"><a href="#cb22-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      model_name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"postprocess_python"</span></span>
<span id="cb22-22"><a href="#cb22-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      model_version<span class="op">:</span> -<span class="dv">1</span></span>
<span id="cb22-23"><a href="#cb22-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      input_map { key<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"LOGITS"</span> value<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"LOGITS"</span> }</span>
<span id="cb22-24"><a href="#cb22-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      output_map { key<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"LABEL"</span> value<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"LABEL"</span> }</span>
<span id="cb22-25"><a href="#cb22-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    }</span>
<span id="cb22-26"><a href="#cb22-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  ]</span>
<span id="cb22-27"><a href="#cb22-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Repo cần đủ 4 model dirs; ensemble version dir có thể có file placeholder.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="sec-serve-artifacts" class="level2" data-number="6.8">
<h2 data-number="6.8" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-serve-artifacts"><span class="header-section-number">6.8</span> Serving ONNX vs TensorRT trong Triton</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Bắt đầu ORT hay TRT — và plan phải khớp profile thế nào?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Bắt đầu ORT</strong> cho correctness/portability; <strong>chuyển TRT</strong> khi profiling chứng minh ORT không đủ. Plan phải build trên target GPU/TRT/CUDA. <code>max_batch_size</code> Triton ≤ <code>max</code> của optimization profile. Engine không portable tuyệt đối (Lesson 4).</p>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Chọn ORT khi</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Chọn TRT khi</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Deploy nhanh, đang experiment</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Latency/throughput GPU critical</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">ONNX đã validate</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Architecture hỗ trợ TRT tốt</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Perf đã đủ SLO</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Benchmark thấy lợi rõ + CI build engine</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre class="text"><code>Start with ONNX Runtime → Move to TensorRT when profiling proves need.</code></pre>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-20-contents" aria-controls="callout-20" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>TRT + dynamic batching
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-20" class="callout-20-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Build: <code>trtexec --onnx=... --fp16 --minShapes=... --optShapes=... --maxShapes=... --saveEngine=model.plan</code>. Đặt Triton <code>max_batch_size</code> trong range profile. Sai profile → runtime shape error dù <code>trtexec</code> local OK trên máy khác.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-rollout" class="level2" data-number="6.9">
<h2 data-number="6.9" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-rollout"><span class="header-section-number">6.9</span> Model management, observability và rollout</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p><code>poll</code> mode có nên là mặc định production không?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Control modes: <strong><code>none</code></strong> (load hết lúc start, immutable — thường tốt production đơn giản), <strong><code>explicit</code></strong> (load có chọn + API), <strong><code>poll</code></strong> (theo dõi filesystem — rủi ro partial update). Health: <code>/v2/health/live</code> vs <code>/ready</code>. Metrics <code>:8002/metrics</code> — tách <strong>queue duration</strong> vs <strong>compute infer duration</strong>. Prefer immutable deploy hoặc explicit; tránh poll mặc định.</p>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 24%">
<col style="width: 36%">
<col style="width: 40%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Mode</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Hành vi</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Khi dùng</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>none</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Load all lúc start; ignore FS changes</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Prod đơn giản, immutable repo/pod</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>explicit</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Load theo <code>--load-model</code> + API</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Nhiều model, on-demand, controlled reload</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>poll</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Poll repo định kỳ</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Chỉ khi atomic update được kiểm soát chặt</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Safer rollout: build → validate schema → correctness → load test → perf baseline → package immutable → deploy pod → readiness → shift traffic dần → monitor p99/error/GPU/queue → rollback nếu SLO vỡ.</p>

<section id="sec-perf-debug" class="level2" data-number="6.10">
<h2 data-number="6.10" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-perf-debug"><span class="header-section-number">6.10</span> Perf Analyzer, Model Analyzer và debug</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Perf Analyzer khác Model Analyzer — và debug batching “không chạy” bắt đầu từ đâu?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Perf Analyzer</strong> = load có kiểm soát để đo thr/latency/p99. <strong>Model Analyzer</strong> = explore config (instance, batch…) tự động hơn. Benchmark matrix: concurrency × batch × config. Đừng tối ưu thr mà bỏ p99/queue/GPU mem. Hầu hết lỗi thuộc: load fail, shape mismatch, batching off, p99 xấu sau batch, util thấp, VRAM cao, plan không tương thích.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb26"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb26-1"><a href="#cb26-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ví dụ — chỉnh model/shape theo lab</span></span>
<span id="cb26-2"><a href="#cb26-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> tiny_classifier_onnx <span class="at">-u</span> localhost:8000 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb26-3"><a href="#cb26-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:16 <span class="at">--shape</span> input:1,1,28,28</span>
<span id="cb26-4"><a href="#cb26-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb26-5"><a href="#cb26-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> tiny_classifier_onnx <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb26-6"><a href="#cb26-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:32 <span class="at">--measurement-interval</span> 10000</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Đừng nhầm <strong>client batch</strong> với <strong>dynamic batch</strong>. Matrix gợi ý: concurrency <code>{1,4,16,64}</code> × configs <code>{no batch, dyn default, delay 100µs, instances 1/2}</code>.</p>
<p>Vẽ throughput curve vs concurrency; tìm điểm GPU saturate / p99 vượt SLO.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 48%">
<col style="width: 51%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Triệu chứng</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Kiểm tra đầu</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Model không load</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Log Triton; path file; <code>config.pbtxt</code>; backend; I/O names; plan/CUDA version</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Shape mismatch</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>max_batch_size</code> vs dims; client gửi <code>[B]+dims</code> đúng chưa</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Dyn batch “không chạy”</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>max_batch_size&gt;0</code>? có <code>dynamic_batching</code>? shapes compatible? traffic đủ?</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">p99 xấu sau batch</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Giảm delay / max batch; tăng instances; so SLO</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Thr thấp + GPU util thấp</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Pre/post CPU? copy? concurrency thấp? Python bottleneck?</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU memory cao</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Giảm instances / max batch; engine profile</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Plan fail trong Triton nhưng <code>trtexec</code> OK</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU/TRT version khác; filename <code>model.plan</code>; input names</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<section id="debug-checklists-đầy-đủ" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="debug-checklists-đầy-đủ">Debug checklists đầy đủ</h3>
<p><strong>Model không load:</strong> layout → version là số nguyên → filename convention → <code>config.pbtxt</code> syntax → backend/platform → I/O names/dtypes/dims → TRT compatibility → plugins.</p>
<p><strong>Shape mismatch</strong> (hay nhất): quên rằng khi <code>max_batch_size &gt; 0</code>, dims <strong>không</strong> gồm batch. Đúng: <code>max_batch_size:32</code> + <code>dims:[3,224,224]</code>. Sai: <code>dims:[1,3,224,224]</code> cùng <code>max_batch_size:32</code>.</p>
<p><strong>Dyn batch không chạy:</strong> <code>max_batch_size&gt;0</code>? có block <code>dynamic_batching</code>? concurrency đủ? shapes compatible? model batchable? client đã gửi batch lớn + concurrency thấp? traffic thấp? quá nhiều instances “nuốt” request trước khi batch lớn? <code>preferred_batch_size</code> quá hẹp? delay quá nhỏ?</p>
<p><strong>p99 xấu sau batch:</strong> queue duration↑? delay/max batch cao? preferred gây chờ? → hạ delay/max batch, bỏ preferred, thêm instance, hoặc tắt dyn batch cho endpoint latency-critical.</p>
<p><strong>Thr thấp + GPU util thấp:</strong> concurrency thấp, network/JSON overhead, pre/post CPU, Python backend, H2D/D2H, gRPC vs HTTP.</p>
<p><strong>VRAM cao:</strong> giảm instances / max batch; kiểm profile engine.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-24-contents" aria-controls="callout-24" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Design patterns và anti-patterns
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-24" class="callout-24-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Patterns:</strong> (1) Single-model: ONNX→TRT plan→dyn batch→metrics. (2) Multi-model: gán GPU/instance theo SLO + memory plan. (3) Pipeline ensemble: Python→TRT→Python. (4) Low-latency: delay≈0, max batch nhỏ, TRT FP16/INT8, protocol nhanh. (5) High-throughput: max batch lớn, delay cao hơn, nhiều instance nếu VRAM cho phép.</p>
<p><strong>Anti-patterns:</strong> copy config internet mù; <code>preferred_batch_size</code> không benchmark; tăng instance đến đầy VRAM; Python backend cho mọi thứ; chỉ đo mean latency; bỏ qua queue duration; poll mode + sửa file không atomic; giả định plan portable mọi GPU.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-25-contents" aria-controls="callout-25" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Production checklist đầy đủ
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-25" class="callout-25-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Artifact:</strong> baseline accuracy+latency; I/O schema; TRT/ORT/CUDA/driver/GPU recorded.<br>
<strong>Repository:</strong> layout; config khớp names/dims; version policy; warmup.<br>
<strong>Runtime:</strong> live/ready; metrics (queue vs compute); batch+instances vs <strong>p99 SLO</strong>.<br>
<strong>Deploy:</strong> immutable image/repo; canary; rollback; monitor error + GPU mem + thr.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>

<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">

</div>

<span class="screen-reader-only">Ghi chú</span>Thực hành — Triton end-to-end (ONNX → serve → batch → optional TRT)
</div>
