<section id="lab-12-export-tinycnn-repository" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-12-export-tinycnn-repository">Lab 1–2: Export TinyCNN + repository</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb27"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb27-1"><a href="#cb27-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mkdir</span> <span class="at">-p</span> triton_lesson_6 <span class="kw">&amp;&amp;</span> <span class="bu">cd</span> triton_lesson_6</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb28"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb28-1"><a href="#cb28-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> torch, torch.nn <span class="im">as</span> nn</span>
<span id="cb28-2"><a href="#cb28-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb28-3"><a href="#cb28-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">class</span> TinyCNN(nn.Module):</span>
<span id="cb28-4"><a href="#cb28-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="kw">def</span> <span class="fu">__init__</span>(<span class="va">self</span>):</span>
<span id="cb28-5"><a href="#cb28-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="bu">super</span>().<span class="fu">__init__</span>()</span>
<span id="cb28-6"><a href="#cb28-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="va">self</span>.net <span class="op">=</span> nn.Sequential(</span>
<span id="cb28-7"><a href="#cb28-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            nn.Conv2d(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, padding<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>), nn.ReLU(),</span>
<span id="cb28-8"><a href="#cb28-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>)), nn.Flatten(), nn.Linear(<span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="dv">10</span>),</span>
<span id="cb28-9"><a href="#cb28-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb28-10"><a href="#cb28-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="kw">def</span> forward(<span class="va">self</span>, x):</span>
<span id="cb28-11"><a href="#cb28-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">return</span> <span class="va">self</span>.net(x)</span>
<span id="cb28-12"><a href="#cb28-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb28-13"><a href="#cb28-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>model <span class="op">=</span> TinyCNN().<span class="bu">eval</span>()</span>
<span id="cb28-14"><a href="#cb28-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>torch.onnx.export(</span>
<span id="cb28-15"><a href="#cb28-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    model, torch.randn(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">28</span>, <span class="dv">28</span>), <span class="st">"model.onnx"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb28-16"><a href="#cb28-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    input_names<span class="op">=</span>[<span class="st">"input"</span>], output_names<span class="op">=</span>[<span class="st">"logits"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb28-17"><a href="#cb28-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    dynamic_axes<span class="op">=</span>{<span class="st">"input"</span>: {<span class="dv">0</span>: <span class="st">"batch"</span>}, <span class="st">"logits"</span>: {<span class="dv">0</span>: <span class="st">"batch"</span>}},</span>
<span id="cb28-18"><a href="#cb28-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    opset_version<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">17</span>,</span>
<span id="cb28-19"><a href="#cb28-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb29"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb29-1"><a href="#cb29-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mkdir</span> <span class="at">-p</span> model_repository/tiny_classifier_onnx/1</span>
<span id="cb29-2"><a href="#cb29-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cp</span> model.onnx model_repository/tiny_classifier_onnx/1/model.onnx</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p><code>config.pbtxt</code> — nhớ ONNX <code>[B,1,28,28]</code> → Triton <code>dims: [1,28,28]</code>, <code>max_batch_size: 8</code> (như <a href="#sec-config" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 6.4</span></a>).</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-34-start-triton-python-client" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-34-start-triton-python-client">Lab 3–4: Start Triton + Python client</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb30"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb30-1"><a href="#cb30-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">export</span> <span class="va">RELEASE</span><span class="op">=</span>26.04</span>
<span id="cb30-2"><a href="#cb30-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">docker</span> run <span class="at">--gpus</span> all <span class="at">--rm</span> <span class="at">-it</span> <span class="at">--net</span> host <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb30-3"><a href="#cb30-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">-v</span> <span class="va">$PWD</span>/model_repository:/models <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb30-4"><a href="#cb30-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:<span class="va">${RELEASE}</span>-py3 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb30-5"><a href="#cb30-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  tritonserver <span class="at">--model-repository</span><span class="op">=</span>/models</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb31"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb31-1"><a href="#cb31-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> numpy <span class="im">as</span> np</span>
<span id="cb31-2"><a href="#cb31-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> tritonclient.http <span class="im">as</span> httpclient</span>
<span id="cb31-3"><a href="#cb31-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb31-4"><a href="#cb31-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>client <span class="op">=</span> httpclient.InferenceServerClient(url<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"localhost:8000"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb31-5"><a href="#cb31-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>x <span class="op">=</span> np.random.randn(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">28</span>, <span class="dv">28</span>).astype(np.float32)</span>
<span id="cb31-6"><a href="#cb31-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>inp <span class="op">=</span> httpclient.InferInput(<span class="st">"input"</span>, x.shape, <span class="st">"FP32"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb31-7"><a href="#cb31-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>inp.set_data_from_numpy(x)</span>
<span id="cb31-8"><a href="#cb31-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>out <span class="op">=</span> httpclient.InferRequestedOutput(<span class="st">"logits"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb31-9"><a href="#cb31-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>result <span class="op">=</span> client.infer(<span class="st">"tiny_classifier_onnx"</span>, inputs<span class="op">=</span>[inp], outputs<span class="op">=</span>[out])</span>
<span id="cb31-10"><a href="#cb31-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(result.as_numpy(<span class="st">"logits"</span>).shape)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</section>
<section id="lab-56-dynamic-batching-instance_group" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-56-dynamic-batching-instance_group">Lab 5–6: Dynamic batching + instance_group</h3>
<p>Baseline config (Lab 2) chưa có batcher. Thêm:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb32"><pre class="sourceCode protobuf code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode protobuf"><span id="cb32-1"><a href="#cb32-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"tiny_classifier_onnx"</span></span>
<span id="cb32-2"><a href="#cb32-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>backend<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"onnxruntime"</span></span>
<span id="cb32-3"><a href="#cb32-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>max_batch_size<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">8</span></span>
<span id="cb32-4"><a href="#cb32-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb32-5"><a href="#cb32-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>input [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"input"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_FP32 dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">28</span>, <span class="dv">28</span> ] }]</span>
<span id="cb32-6"><a href="#cb32-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>output [{ name<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">"logits"</span> data_type<span class="op">:</span> TYPE_FP32 dims<span class="op">:</span> [ <span class="dv">10</span> ] }]</span>
<span id="cb32-7"><a href="#cb32-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb32-8"><a href="#cb32-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>dynamic_batching {</span>
<span id="cb32-9"><a href="#cb32-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  max_queue_delay_microseconds<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">100</span></span>
<span id="cb32-10"><a href="#cb32-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span>
<span id="cb32-11"><a href="#cb32-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb32-12"><a href="#cb32-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>instance_group [{ count<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">2</span> kind<span class="op">:</span> KIND_GPU }]</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Restart Triton. So Perf Analyzer concurrency <code>{1,4,16}</code> trước/sau. Ghi thr, p50, p99. Thử bỏ <code>preferred_batch_size</code> (đừng thêm nếu chưa đo). Hỏi: thr↑ bao nhiêu? p99 có vượt SLO giả định (ví dụ 30ms) không?</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-79-tensorrt-plan-python-preprocess-ensemble" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-79-tensorrt-plan-python-preprocess-ensemble">Lab 7–9: TensorRT plan, Python preprocess, ensemble</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb33"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb33-1"><a href="#cb33-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model.plan <span class="at">--fp16</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb33-2"><a href="#cb33-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--minShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:1x1x28x28 <span class="at">--optShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:4x1x28x28 <span class="at">--maxShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>input:8x1x28x28</span>
<span id="cb33-3"><a href="#cb33-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb33-4"><a href="#cb33-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mkdir</span> <span class="at">-p</span> model_repository/tiny_classifier_trt/1</span>
<span id="cb33-5"><a href="#cb33-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cp</span> model.plan model_repository/tiny_classifier_trt/1/model.plan</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Config TRT: <code>platform: "tensorrt_plan"</code>, <code>max_batch_size: 8</code>, dims <code>[1,28,28]</code>, optional <code>dynamic_batching {}</code>.<br>
Python preprocess: copy skeleton <a href="#sec-instances" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 6.7</span></a>. Ensemble optional: map preprocess → classifier (@ tip ensemble).</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-10-metrics" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-10-metrics">Lab 10: Metrics</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb34"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb34-1"><a href="#cb34-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">curl</span> <span class="at">-s</span> localhost:8002/metrics <span class="kw">|</span> <span class="fu">head</span></span>
<span id="cb34-2"><a href="#cb34-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">perf_analyzer</span> <span class="at">-m</span> tiny_classifier_onnx <span class="at">-u</span> localhost:8000 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb34-3"><a href="#cb34-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--concurrency-range</span> 1:16</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Quan sát queue vs compute; GPU util khi concurrency tăng.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-27-contents" aria-controls="callout-27" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Mini project report
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-27" class="callout-27-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>ONNX + TRT FP16 → dyn batch → instance tune → Perf Analyzer → <code>/metrics</code> → chọn production candidate. Bảng: Config | Backend | Dyn batch | Instances | Max batch | Delay || thr | p50 | p95 | p99 | GPU util | mem. Ghi bottleneck, rủi ro, rollback.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="checkpoint-questions" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="checkpoint-questions">Checkpoint questions</h2>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-28-contents" aria-controls="callout-28" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Tự kiểm
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-28" class="callout-28-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>Triton vs TensorRT? Serving vs compile/execute engine.<br>
</li>
<li>Triton vs ORT? Server đa model/batch/metrics vs runtime.<br>
</li>
<li>Repo layout? <code>name/config.pbtxt/version/file</code>.<br>
</li>
<li>Config tối thiểu? name/backend, max_batch_size, input/output.<br>
</li>
<li><code>max_batch_size&gt;0</code> → dims <strong>không</strong> gồm batch.<br>
</li>
<li><code>max_batch_size:0</code> khi không batch / full dims.<br>
</li>
<li>Dyn batch? Gom request server-side thành batch lớn hơn.<br>
</li>
<li>Thr↑ p99↓? Queue delay + batch lớn hơn.<br>
</li>
<li><code>max_queue_delay</code>? Chờ thêm peer → batch↑, latency risk↑.<br>
</li>
<li><code>preferred_batch_size</code>? Chỉ khi benchmark chứng minh.<br>
</li>
<li>Instance count ≠ batch size.<br>
</li>
<li>Tăng instance khi chưa saturate / nhiều concurrent.<br>
</li>
<li>Giảm khi VRAM/contention.<br>
</li>
<li>ORT dễ/portable; TRT nhanh hơn, kém portable.<br>
</li>
<li>Plan phụ thuộc GPU/TRT version.<br>
</li>
<li>Python: pre/post/glue — cẩn bottleneck.<br>
</li>
<li>Ensemble không tự compute.<br>
</li>
<li>none / explicit / poll.<br>
</li>
<li>Poll: partial FS update.<br>
</li>
<li>Queue vs compute metrics.<br>
</li>
<li>Perf Analyzer = load test; Model Analyzer = explore configs.<br>
</li>
<li>thr + p50/p95/p99 + GPU util/mem + queue.<br>
</li>
<li>Batching off: max_batch, config block, shapes, traffic.<br>
</li>
<li>Util thấp + latency cao: CPU pre/post, copy, queue, concurrency.<br>
</li>
<li>p99 sau batch: giảm delay/max batch; thêm instance; đối chiếu SLO.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="summary" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="summary">Summary</h2>
<ol type="1">
<li>Triton = serving layer quanh artifact đã tối ưu.<br>
</li>
<li>Repository + <code>config.pbtxt</code> là hợp đồng deploy.<br>
</li>
<li><code>max_batch_size</code> đổi nghĩa <code>dims</code> — đừng nhầm shape.<br>
</li>
<li>Dynamic batching và instances tune theo <strong>SLO</strong>, không chỉ thr.<br>
</li>
<li>Observable: health + metrics (queue vs compute) + Perf Analyzer.<br>
</li>
<li>Rollout immutable/explicit; tránh poll mặc định.</li>
</ol>
</section>
